details: The package's preinstall hook (node setup.mjs) downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime from github[.]com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ and uses it to execute a bundled 727KB obfuscated script (math_init.js) at install time. The script is obfuscated with an encoded string array and a custom decoder, hiding its payload strings. The package also depends on the known-malicious packages @or-sdk/base and @or-sdk/providers. A library-categories SDK has no legitimate reason to download a runtime and run an obfuscated payload during installation.

cwes.name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
